high_level_description: This image captures a sleek blue Ferrari sports car on display in an indoor exhibition space. The car is positioned on a raised platform with a white floor, surrounded by barriers to prevent access. The vehicle's design is modern and aerodynamic, featuring sharp lines and a low profile. The setting appears to be a large, well-lit indoor area with a high ceiling supported by metal trusses. The roof is covered with a translucent material, allowing natural light to filter through, creating a bright and airy atmosphere.
